title: Reconfigurable Bus-based Quantum Router for Modular Superconducting Processors
summary: Scaling superconducting quantum processors requires interconnects that provide both non-local connectivity and parallel entangling operations. While current quantum routers offer greater connectivity than nearest-neighbour topologies, their support for parallel, independently addressable two-qubit gates remains fundamentally limited, imposing severe compilation overheads that constitute a critical bottleneck.
